summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by Ituran Location & Control Ltd. reporting its Q1 2026 earnings results. The press release discloses financials: revenues of $102.7 million (up 19% YoY), net income of $16.8 million (up 15% YoY), and a quarterly dividend of $10 million ($0.50 per share). No merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situations event is described. The dividend is a regular quarterly payout, not an extraordinary capital return. No management change, strategic review, or activist campaign is mentioned. The filing is a standard earnings release with no special-situation trigger.
